bullets: Develop 2 Spring Boot microservices and their REST APIs within an application modernization and migration program, delivering full-stack features across Java, Spring Boot, and React.

Reduced API response time from 200ms to 20ms by introducing Redis caching for frequently accessed data, and integrated Apache Kafka across 5 topics to decouple services through asynchronous, event-driven processing.
Own end-to-end deployment for both services by authoring Dockerfiles and Kubernetes manifests, enabling containerized, repeatable delivery to the cluster.

Redesigned iteration-run retrieval for Microsoft Fabric FMLV REST APIs, replacing repeated File System initialization with batch initialization and map-based lookups, reducing lookup complexity from O(n) to O(1) and improving scalability as iteration counts grew.

Remediated 70+ security vulnerabilities (CVEs) in Apache Ambari by tracing transitive-dependency chains, upgrading affected packages, and validating compatibility across a legacy codebase with zero functional regressions.
Replaced browser-driven E2E validation with a reusable HTTP client automation framework across 100+ API endpoints, raising automation reliability from 70% to 100% and cutting execution time by 40%.
